queries.name: source_identity_and_planner_stats
queries.sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'identity',jsonb_build_object('db',current_database(),'actor',current_user,'sessionActor',session_user,'version',current_setting('server_version_num'),'ro',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),'isolation',current_setting('transaction_isolation'),'statement',current_setting('statement_timeout'),'lock',current_setting('lock_timeout'),'tls',(SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()),'epoch',pg_postmaster_start_time()),
 'settings',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(name,setting) FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('work_mem','jit','random_page_cost','seq_page_cost','cpu_tuple_cost','cpu_operator_cost','effective_cache_size','enable_nestloop','enable_hashjoin','enable_mergejoin','plan_cache_mode')),
 'statistics',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,'reltuples',c.reltuples,'relpages',c.relpages,'liveEstimate',s.n_live_tup,'modSinceAnalyze',s.n_mod_since_analyze,'lastAnalyze',s.last_analyze,'lastAutoAnalyze',s.last_autoanalyze,'analyzeCount',s.analyze_count,'autoanalyzeCount',s.autoanalyze_count,'ingestMaintain',has_table_privilege('orion_pro_ingest',c.oid,'MAINTAIN'),'ownerMaintain',has_table_privilege('orion_pro_owner',c.oid,'MAINTAIN')) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_all_tables s ON s.relid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname='football' AND c.relname IN ('player_match_metric_values','match_players','player_match_stats')))

Plans.Merge Cond: ((a.match_id = b.match_id) AND (a.player_id = b.player_id) AND (a.period_code = b.period_code) AND (a.family_code = b.family_code) AND (a.metric_code = b.metric_code))
Plans.Join Filter: ((a.revision_id < b.revision_id) AND (a.recorded_from_gen < COALESCE(b.recorded_to_gen, '9223372036854775807'::bigint)) AND (b.recorded_from_gen < COALESCE(a.recorded_to_gen, '9223372036854775807'::bigint)) AND (a.variant_key = b.variant_key) AND ((a.recorded_from_gen = 2) OR (a.recorded_to_gen = 2) OR (b.recorded_from_gen = 2) OR (b.recorded_to_gen = 2)))

queries.name: 241 Selected parent membership differs at generation: football.player_match_metric_values / football_player_match_metric_values_metric_code_fk
queries.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, SETTINGS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" child JOIN "football"."metric_definitions" anchor ON anchor."code" = child."metric_code" AND anchor."definition_version" = child."metric_definition_version" WHERE ingest.selected_at(2,child."recorded_from_gen",child."recorded_to_gen") AND child."is_canonical" AND NOT child."is_deleted" AND child."metric_code" IS NOT NULL AND child."metric_definition_version" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "football"."metric_definitions" selected_parent WHERE ingest.selected_at(2,selected_parent."recorded_from_gen",selected_parent."recorded_to_gen") AND selected_parent."code" = anchor."code"))

Plans.Filter: (is_canonical AND (NOT is_deleted) AND ingest.selected_at('2'::bigint, recorded_from_gen, recorded_to_gen))

queries.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, SETTINGS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "football"."player_match_metric_values" child JOIN "football"."match_players" anchor ON anchor."match_id" = child."match_id" AND anchor."player_id" = child."player_id" AND anchor."team_id" = child."team_id" AND anchor."revision_id" = child."match_player_revision_id" WHERE ingest.selected_at(2,child."recorded_from_gen",child."recorded_to_gen") AND child."is_canonical" AND NOT child."is_deleted" AND child."match_id" IS NOT NULL AND child."player_id" IS NOT NULL AND child."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND child."match_player_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "football"."match_players" selected_parent WHERE ingest.selected_at(2,selected_parent."recorded_from_gen",selected_parent."recorded_to_gen") AND selected_parent."is_canonical" AND NOT selected_parent."is_deleted" AND selected_parent."match_id" = anchor."match_id" AND selected_parent."player_id" = anchor."player_id" AND selected_parent."position_code" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM anchor."position_code" AND selected_parent."team_id" = anchor."team_id"))
